title: Earning Marlowe Rewards Points on Dispatched Orders
content:
Marlowe Rewards points post when an order is dispatched. They are earned on the order's qualifying spend: the merchandise price actually charged after every discount.

## What counts as qualifying spend

- **Excluded:** shipping fees, sales tax, gift card purchases, and the part of the order paid with Marlowe Rewards Notes.
- **Included:** the part paid with gift cards, Return Store Credit or Goodwill Credit, which earns like any other payment.

## How many points

Points equal the qualifying spend, multiplied by the base points per USD and by the tier points multiplier of the tier held on the posting date. The result is rounded to the nearest whole point, a half point rounding up. The tier and multiplier used are recorded on the earning entry.

## When the points can be used

The points become available on the posting date plus the pending period, counted in calendar days. Until then they are pending.

## When an order earns

- Points post only while the membership is in status active or suspended.
- An order placed while the customer had no open membership earns nothing.
- One posting is made per order, at dispatch.
- A split shipment posts once, on the first dispatch, for the whole order's qualifying spend.

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

| Merchandise charged after discounts | Shipping | Tax | Qualifying spend | Base rate and multiplier assumed | Unrounded | Points posted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100.00 | 7.95 | 8.10 | 100.00 | 1 and 1.25 | 125 | 125 |
| 85.30 | 0.00 | 6.90 | 85.30 | 1 and 1.25 | 106.625 | 107 |
| 42.10 | 5.95 | 3.40 | 42.10 | 1 and 1.50 | 63.15 | 63 |

## Points of judgement

- **Split shipments.** A hypothetical order shipped in two parcels on 3 May and 9 May posts once, on 3 May, for the whole order.
- **Suspended members.** A suspended membership still receives earning postings.
- **Orders from before joining.** An order placed before the customer enrolled earns nothing at dispatch.
